name: Taiga PM: rootless Podman Compose
description: Rootless Podman Compose stack for Taiga project management: nginx entry point, documented secrets, volume layout, and backup scripts.
longDescription: Infrastructure-as-code for running Taiga without a Docker daemon. Podman Compose defines nginx as the HTTP entry, application workers, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ with explicit volume mounts for predictable permissions and backups. Deployment flow covers environment templates, persistent data directories, first-boot admin setup, and optional template loading. Shell scripts support backup and restore. Documentation covers rootless setups on Linux and WSL.
features: Single HTTP entry via nginx reverse proxy
Rootless-first documentation for Linux and WSL
Volume layout for database, media, static assets, and messaging
Guidance for performant storage on WSL hosts
role: Platform engineering and internal PM hosting
highlights: Rootless Podman reduces daemon attack surface for long-running collaboration software
Single nginx entry simplifies TLS and access rules
Operational scripts and documented secret generation for first boot
challenges: Multi-service PM stacks are sensitive to volume permissions and async workers.
solutions: Documented directory preparation, strong generated secrets, and compose runbooks for reliable first boot.
security: Generate strong secrets for application, database, and messaging services
Do not expose the HTTP port broadly without TLS termination
